firstPartyClosure.method: Maintained staticImportClosure over exact Git-object virtual filesystem; traverses identical and differing first-party files. Bare package imports remain outside this helper. The nine Gitlink edges were resolved from recursive source pins and continued with the same scanner; previously scanned first-party files were reused as exact-source boundaries.
firstPartyClosure.scope: 48 exact reviewed roots from the unchanged proposal. The scan traverses every reachable first-party relative/alias/literal-runtime path, including identical and differing existing files.
firstPartyClosure.limitation: This is a conservative syntactic source boundary, not a minimal admission path list. Identical files are traversed to expose their imports. Package source files behind bare imports are represented by exact lock placements, manifests and pinned package/gitlink inputs; their runtime module graph and conditional exports still require qualification.

packageBoundary.method: TypeScript preProcessFile over complete enumerated static first-party closure and resolved Gitlink continuations; group import occurrences by exact specifier plus nearest lock placement. Follow all local dependency/optional/peer/dev declarations.

originalRootPackageScan.method: TypeScript preProcessFile imports for reviewed roots; nearest Node-style lock package entry; follow every local manifest dependency, optional, peer and development declaration via pinned recursive Git objects. Package exports are declarations, not an executed resolver proof.

decision.conclusion: The 48 reviewed paths do not form a complete selective source boundary against d740. A conservative traversal reaches 2012 first-party paths that differ from or are absent at d740, plus pinned submodule continuation and 84 local package manifests.
decision.route: Continue qualification of one coherent immutable containing artifact, or independently establish compatibility for each omitted differing dependency before any separately owned selective admission. This receipt neither selects nor widens any frozen candidate.
requiredQualification: Use exactly d4dc source tree, source package-lock and recursive gitlinks; no mixed source/reference inputs.
Resolve conditional package exports, nonliteral runtime loading and the actual installed generation through the maintained qualification route.
Run appropriate conventional tests and required typechecks on the immutable containing artifact; scoped textual evidence is not sufficient.

Preserve historical native21024594 and retained R2 rows21034313/21034330/21034341; final R7/SPEC-WOE-SHIP require the qualified exact deployed artifact and isolated runner/shared ledger, followed by R5 and independent acceptance.

limitations: A syntactic conservative closure is not an API compatibility proof or a qualified artifact.
Package conditional exports, nonliteral dynamic/runtime loading and installed contents are unexecuted.
The closure is review evidence and cannot widen any frozen admission.
